data.name: Plum
data.detailed_description:
Roll, bounce, and travel through an entire little world full of plums.

About the Game

Plum is a short (about 1h) contemplative 3D collectathon, where you play as a plum, rolling and bouncing your way through a colorful world, searching for your way home. Your journey will take you through lands, caves, snowy mountains and more. Each area with ghost plums to meet, each with a story to tell.

The game was mostly made for cozy players, young players, and eventually speedrunners.

Content

  • Roll and bounce through linear levels designed as a cosy journey, simple exploration and easy platforming difficulty.

  • Meet 20 plum-ghosts, each with their own hand-written dialogue and their own story to share. (Meeting plums is not mandatory to finish the game, still, they carry the story. It's up to you.)

  • Collect plum essences at your own pace. Collectibles add depth, but are never required to finish the game

  • An original fully human made soundtrack blending ambient, composed specifically for the journey.

Note from the Dev

First published game from Mad Arena Games, Plum is the result of work from a self-made solo developer.

The scope of the game reflects my will to provide the best player experience I possibly can in the time allowed to work on it and with a complete story and original music made by me.

I hope you'll enjoy this journey as much as I enjoyed learning and making it. This is only the beginning.

On your way, meet different ghost plums each which a story to share. This game is a colorful stylized short adventure (about 1h) made to chill or speedrunning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3550H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Size will increase for the release - 2Go is for the demo.

  • OS: windows 11
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
